message.content:
Based on my search, here is how to access your Wells Fargo credit card account:

## Wells Fargo Credit Card Login Options

### 1. Online (Desktop/Laptop)
- Go to **https://www.wellsfargo.com/**
- Click **"Sign On"** in the upper right corner
- Enter your **Username** and **Password**
- If you haven't enrolled yet, click **"Enroll"** and follow the prompts using your credit card number, Social Security Number, and date of birth

### 2. Mobile App
- Download the **Wells Fargo Mobile® app** from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android)
- Open the app and tap **"Sign On"**
- Enter your username and password (same as online banking)
- Enable Face ID, Touch ID, or biometric login for faster future access

### 3. Phone Access
- Call the number on the back of your credit card
- Wells Fargo Customer Service: **1-866-382-4951**

## What You Can Do Once Logged In
- View statements and transaction history
- Make payments (one-time or set up AutoPay)
- Set up account alerts
- Lock/unlock your card if lost or stolen
- Request a credit limit increase
- Dispute transactions
- Redeem rewards
- Download statements

## Forgot Your Login?
- Click **"Forgot Password/Username?"** on the sign-on page
- Verify your identity with your card number, SSN, and other personal information
- Reset your credentials via email or text verification

## Security Tips
- Never save your password on shared devices
- Enable two-factor authentication when available
- Use the app's "Card Lock" feature immediately if you suspect fraud
- Wells Fargo will never ask for your password via email or phone
